cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What changed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened to the building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.text: Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What arrangement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is it broken?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you tell me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.text: You ignored the wobble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There is no cake now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a speed contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. A narrow category. How many wildflowers did you notice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I noticed the finish line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I also win for variety of attention.

beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.text: Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
